title: FB-010 align rename apply scope evidence
summary: Align WebView Rename apply-scope evidence with the active unchecked all-applicable apply behavior.
reason: Worker finding FR-031 identified stale Rename Batch Safety copy that said no checked rows applies only the selected detail row while the active Apply path submits all applicable safe preview rows.
